title: leaderstats
summary: A magic Folder name: create a Folder named exactly 'leaderstats' inside a Player, put value objects in it, and Roblox shows them on the built-in leaderboard — zero GUI work.

explanation.whatItIs: Convention-as-code: the engine scans each Player for a child Folder named 'leaderstats' and renders its value-object children in the stock leaderboard UI.
explanation.whyItExists: Every game needs scores; one naming convention replaces boilerplate UI.
whenToUse: Server Script in PlayerAdded: build the folder + IntValue/StringValue children
Updating stats by writing .Value — the board updates automatically
Order on the board follows child order
whenNotToUse: For anything not shown as a leaderboard stat — attributes/regular folders
Client-side creation — the server should own stats
tips: Name must be exact (case-sensitive) and parented to the Player
Rebuild in PlayerAdded — stats don't survive respawns (they're on Player, not Character, so they DO persist across deaths within a session)
Persist values yourself (DataStore) — leaderstats is display only
commonMistakes: Misspelling 'leaderstats' (capital S, etc.) — silently no leaderboard
Parenting to Character instead of Player
Expecting built-in saving — it's display, not storage

examples.title: Standard setup
examples.code:
-- Server Script
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
    stats.Name = "leaderstats"      -- exact name!

    local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
    coins.Name = "Coins"
    coins.Value = 0
    coins.Parent = stats

    local level = Instance.new("IntValue")
    level.Name = "Level"
    level.Value = 1
    level.Parent = stats

    stats.Parent = player            -- parent to PLAYER

    coins.Value += 10                -- leaderboard updates live
end)
